wiki_article:
**Record #1018** is a superseded duplicate mint for the Emily Dickinson canon provenance node.

Its title and registry identify Dickinson, but the seated body is the Sappho canon node. The restoration therefore cannot support any Dickinson-specific description, relation, textual ground, or canon role.

The authoritative Dickinson node is Alexanarch record #180, corresponding to DOI `10.5281/zenodo.20629202`. Record #1018 should preserve only the historical duplicate mint, dead DOI, supersession relation, and wrong-object evidence.

The Sappho body must not be used to infer a shared role between Sappho and Dickinson. Any relation between them belongs to the authoritative canon registry and poet-specific nodes, not to this contamination event.
